_comment: Idaho 2026 QAP thresholds: the seven 4.9 Application Thresholds (pp.20-23) plus the 4.4 development team requirement. The Section 9 architectural requirements, Exhibit E underwriting and the Section 1.4 fair housing and accessibility requirements are incorporated elsewhere and not itemised.

criteria.quote: incorporate a combination of individual green building components into their design whose total value is eight (8) points or more
criteria.note: Met by a certifiable green building program standard, or components worth at least 8 points on the QAP's component list. These are threshold points, not selection points.
